lines.speaker: cortex
lines.text: Welcome to Dimension-Y, little putter. Slicer and I rule here together. My stone generals do not blink. He does not miss.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Two demons for the price of one. Cute. I have beaten worse with a seven iron and a bad attitude.

lines.speaker: slicer
lines.text: Cortex counts the turns. I deliver the blow. Together we are the boss of Dimension-Y.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Then split the partnership. Hit the boss while their attack is counting down and the hit cancels the whole charge. Even the laser.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Interrupt the wind-up, then punish the pair. Got it. Caddy, call the line.

lines.speaker: cortex
lines.text: So this is the golfer who keeps slipping through portals. Slicer, we expected a warrior. We got a bag of clubs.

lines.speaker: slicer
lines.text: My missiles remember every tee. When our countdown completes, there will be nothing left to remember.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Then I will interrupt the countdown. You two are not the first double act I have broken.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Any direct hit on the boss while their attack counts down cancels it and fires a pulse that clears your placed modifiers. Even the laser can be stopped.

lines.speaker: slicer
lines.text: Hit us if you can. The void is patient, and together we have six lives.
